title: Transaction
description:
A group of commands applied atomically (all or nothing) as ONE undo step.
Times are in flicks (1 second = 705600000). Clip, track, marker and sequence-settings
commands target the ACTIVE sequence (`SetActiveSequence` changes it).

label.description: Short human-readable description shown in the history, e.g. "Remove silences".

AddClip.description:
Place a media on a track. If the media has audio, linked audio clips are created with ids
`<id>.a1`, `<id>.a2`… on the first audio tracks that are free over that range (with
`overwrite`: the first unlocked audio tracks). Clips split by `insert` or `overwrite` get
ids starting with `<id>.`.

at.description: Timeline position (snapped to the nearest sequence frame).

duration.description: Default: rest of the media from `source_in` (5 s for a still image).

id.description: New clip id, generated by the caller.

mode.description: Default `free`: fails if the range is not free.

source_in.description: Start point inside the media. Default 0.

track.description: Video track for a video or image media, audio track for an audio-only media.

marker.description: The id is generated by the caller.

AddTextClip.description:
Add a text clip (title, lower third) on a video track.
The text is centered on `position` (default: center of the frame). Animate its entrance
with keyframes: on `opacity`, `scale`, `position`, or on `text_reveal` (0 → 1) for a
typewriter / word cascade (`style.reveal_unit`, `style.reveal_effect`).
Example, a title at the top for 3 s:
`{id: "<new id>", track: "v2", at: 0, duration: 2116800000, text: "Day 1",
 style: {font_family: "Anton", font_size: 140, uppercase: true}, position: {x: 0, y: -600}}`.

at.description: Timeline position (snapped to the nearest frame).

duration.description: Default: the project still image duration (5 s).

id.description: New clip id, generated by the caller.

mode.description: Default `free`: fails if the range is not free.

position.description: Offset of the text center from the frame center, in sequence pixels.

style.description: Style changes from the default (white Montserrat 800, 96 px, centered).

id.description: New track id, generated by the caller.

index.description: Display position. Default: after the last track of the same kind.

AddTransition.description:
Put a transition on the cut at the END of `clip` (between `clip` and the clip that starts
exactly where it ends, on the same track). It is centered on the cut and uses media
beyond both clip edges: without enough media the command fails with
`not_enough_material`, which gives the longest possible duration. A transition already on
that cut is replaced. On a video track, linked audio clips meeting at the same cut get a
constant-power audio crossfade too (ids `<id>.a1`, `<id>.a2`...).
Example, a 1 s cross dissolve after clip c1:
`{id: "<new id>", clip: "c1", kind: "crossfade", duration: 705600000}`.

clip.description: The clip on the LEFT of the cut.

id.description: New transition id, generated by the caller.

with_audio.description: Default true: also crossfade the linked audio at the same cut.

Animatable.description: A property value that is either constant or animated by keyframes.

oneOf.description: Sorted by time, at least one keyframe.

Animatable2.description: A property value that is either constant or animated by keyframes.

oneOf.description: Sorted by time, at least one keyframe.

corner_radius.description: Corner radius in pixels (ignored for `pill`, always fully rounded).

padding.description: Space between the text and the edge of the background, in pixels.

shape.description: `box`: one rectangle behind the whole text; `pill`: one rounded shape per line.

ClearAnimation.description:
Remove the whole animation of a property (or of every property of the clip when `prop` is
omitted). The property keeps its value at `at` (relative to the clip start, default 0).

audio_stream.description:
Audio clips: index of the source audio stream played (0 = first). Ignored for video.
`#[serde(default)]` : un projet enregistré avant ce champ se charge avec 0.

enabled.description: A disabled clip stays on the timeline but is not rendered nor heard.

link.description: Clips sharing a link (a video and its audio) move, trim and split together.

source_in.description: Start point inside the source media.

timeline_start.description: Position on the timeline, aligned on sequence frames.

clean_voice.description:
Voice cleaning (see `SetCleanVoice`): noise reduction made for speech, from 0 (off) to
1 (strongest). Audio clips only.

crop.description: Crop and rounded corners (V4), as fractions of the image.

fade_in.description:
Fade at the start of the clip (V4), multiplied with the opacity (video) or the volume
(audio) keyframes. `fade_in + fade_out` never exceeds the clip duration.

fade_out.description: Fade at the end of the clip (V4).

speed.description: Playback speed (V4): constant. Media clips only.

volume_db.description: Gain in decibels. 0 = unchanged, -6 = half amplitude.

ClipSource.description:
What a clip shows or plays: a media file, a text (V3) or a shape (V3). Later
(knowledge/08): component instances.

oneOf.description: A text clip (fields of `TextSource` next to `type`).

Command.description: One editing command. `type` selects the command.

ConformStrategy.description: How existing clips adapt when the sequence size or ratio changes.

oneOf.description: The whole old frame stays visible in the new one (bars if the ratio differs).
The old frame covers the new one (edges cropped if the ratio differs).
Clips keep their size in pixels, positions anchored to the center.

CopiedKeyframe.description: One copied keyframe, its time relative to the first copied keyframe.

CreateSequence.description:
Create a new empty sequence (one video track `<id>.v1`, one audio track `<id>.a1`) and make
it the active one. Omitted settings come from the project defaults.

id.description: New sequence id, generated by the caller.

Crop.description:
Crop of a clip image, as fractions of its width or height (0 = nothing removed).
`left + right` and `top + bottom` stay below 0.99.

radius.description:
Rounded corners of the visible part: 0 = square, 1 = as round as possible (half of
its shorter side).

CropPatch.description: Changes to a crop. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

DeleteClips.description:
Delete clips (and their linked clips). With `ripple`, following clips on the same
tracks shift left to close the gaps.

DuckingChange.description:
Ducking settings of a track. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Example, music 15 dB under
the voice: `{enabled: true, amount_db: -15}`.

amount_db.description: Volume change under the voice, in dB, -40 to 0 (default -12).

attack.description: Time to go down when the voice starts, 0 to 1 s (default 0.05 s).

release.description: Time to come back after the voice, 0 to 2 s (default 0.5 s).

DuplicateClip.description:
Copy a clip (with its linked clips, properties and keyframes) to another place: copy and
paste, Alt-drag. Copies of linked clips get ids `<new_id>.2`, `<new_id>.3`…

at.description: Timeline position of the copy (snapped to the nearest frame).

new_id.description: Id of the copy, generated by the caller.

track.description:
Track of the copy (same kind). Default: the track of the original. Linked copies stay
on the tracks of their originals.

DuplicateSequence.description:
Copy a sequence (tracks, clips, markers, settings) and make the copy active, e.g. to try
another format on the same edit. Ids inside the copy are derived: `<new_id>.<old id>`.

new_id.description: Id of the copy, generated by the caller.

oneOf.description: Keep the value until the next keyframe (no interpolation).

CSS-like cubic bezier. `x1` and `x2` in [0, 1]; `y1` and `y2` may go beyond [0, 1] to
overshoot (e.g. back out: 0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1).

Spring that settles exactly on the next keyframe (V5). `bounce` in [0, 1]: 0 = no
overshoot, 0.4 = bouncy, 0.8 = elastic. Its duration is the segment's.

EditMode.description: How a new clip is placed when something is already there (classic three-point editing).

oneOf.description: Fail if the range is not free (default).

Replace what is under the new clip, on its tracks and on the tracks of clips linked to
what gets cut. Nothing moves in time.

Push everything at `at` and after to the right, on every unlocked track, to make room.
Clips crossing `at` are split.

Fade.description: A fade at the start (`fade_in`) or end (`fade_out`) of a clip.

duration.description: Length of the fade, from the clip edge.

FadeChange.description: A fade to set on one edge.

curve.description:
Default: the current curve of that fade, else `constant_power` for audio clips and
`s_curve` for video clips.

duration.description: Length of the fade (0 removes it). Snapped to sequence frames.

FadeCurve.description: Shape of a fade. Audio default: `constant_power`; video default: `s_curve`.

oneOf.description: Audio: keeps the perceived loudness steady (-3 dB at mid-fade).
Slow at both ends.
Audio: linear in decibels (-60 dB to 0 dB).
Video: fast at first, then gentle.

Flicks.description:
A point in time or a duration, in flicks (1 flick = 1/705,600,000 second).
Example: 1 second = 705600000, one frame at 25 fps = 28224000.

radius.description: Size of the halo in pixels.

ImportFonts.description:
Make font files (TTF, OTF) available to the text clips of this project. Their family names
then work in `font_family`. Already imported files are ignored.

ImportMedia.description:
Register files in the project. Probe, proxy and waveform then run in the background;
their result comes back through `SetMediaInfo`.

fingerprint.description: Size + hash of the first and last megabytes (computed by the caller).

id.description: New media id, generated by the caller.

easing.description: Interpolation from this keyframe to the next one.
Interpolation from this keyframe to the next one.

KeyframeRef.description: A keyframe, addressed by its clip, property and exact time (relative to the clip start).

LiftRange.description:
Lift: remove the time range [start, end) from the given tracks and leave a gap (nothing
moves). Clips crossing the range are trimmed or split; split right parts get ids
`<id_prefix>.<n>`. Every track holding a clip linked to an affected clip must be listed.

id_prefix.description: Prefix for the ids of clips created by splits, generated by the caller.

LinkClips.description: Link clips so they move, trim and split together. They must share position and duration.

link.description: New link id, generated by the caller.

LinkId.description: Link id: clips sharing a link (video + its audio) move, trim and split together.

Marker.description:
A marker on the timeline ruler. `author` and `resolved` prepare review comments
(knowledge/09).

MediaInfo.description: Probe result of a media file.

audio_streams.description: Number of audio streams. Each one gets its own linked audio clip.

duration.description: Total duration. Ignored for still images.

fps.description: Nominal frame rate (ignored for audio-only and images).

width.description: Video size in pixels (0 for audio-only).

oneOf.description: Video file, with or without audio.
Audio-only file.
Still image (PNG, JPG): no intrinsic duration.
A good take, kept for the edit ("F" in the Logging layout).
A take to ignore ("X").
The in/out points set in the source monitor ("I" / "O"). At most one per media.

MoveClip.description:
Move a clip in time (and optionally to another track of the same kind).
Linked clips move by the same amount in time and stay on their tracks.

at.description: New timeline position of the clip start (snapped to the nearest frame).

MoveKeyframes.description:
Move keyframes in time by `delta` (positive = later). They must stay within their clip.
A moved keyframe replaces a keyframe that was not moved at the same time.

Origin.description: Who produced a transaction (shown with an icon in the history panel).

oneOf.description: A plugin (extension) acting with the `project:write` permission; the label names it.

Paint.description: A solid color or a linear gradient.

angle.description: Direction in degrees: 0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom.

PasteClips.description:
Paste clips from a snapshot taken when they were copied, even if the originals were deleted
since (cut and paste). One group of linked clips per command: the first clip is placed at
`at`, the others keep their offset. Copies get ids `<new_id>`, `<new_id>.2`, `<new_id>.3`…

at.description: Timeline position of the first copy (snapped to the nearest frame).

new_id.description: Id of the first copy, generated by the caller.

PasteKeyframes.description:
Paste copied keyframes on a clip, the first one at `at` (relative to the clip start),
relative times kept. Each one replaces a keyframe at the same time on the same property.

PastedClip.description: A copied clip and the track it goes back to.

PathPoint.description:
A point of a text path. Handles are offsets from `position` ({0, 0} = sharp corner):
`in_handle` shapes the curve arriving at the point, `out_handle` the curve leaving it.

PropPath.description:
Address of an animatable clip property. Les propriétés sont adressées par ce chemin
typé, pas par des champs codés en dur dans l'UI (knowledge/02, « Anticiper l'après-POC »).

oneOf.description: Number, in dB.
Number in [0, 1].
Vec2, in sequence pixels from the center.
Vec2 (V7): width and height factors, multiplied with `scale`. `{x: 1, y: 1}` = unchanged.
Number, in degrees.
Vec2, not animatable.

Text clips only: number in [0, 1], fraction of the words (or letters) shown. Keyframes
from 0 to 1 make a typewriter or a word-by-word cascade.

`{text_animator: {animator: "a1", param: "offset"}}`. Numbers: `start`, `end`, `offset`,
`amount`, `opacity`, `scale`, `rotation`, `blur`, `tracking`. Vec2: `position`.
Text clips laid along a path (0.3): distance along the path, in pixels.

PropValue.description: Value for a property: a number or a 2D vector, depending on the `PropPath`.

RangeId.description: Id of a range marked on a media (favorite, rejected or in/out points).

Rational.description:
A rational number, used for frame rates and time bases.
Example: 29.97 fps is `{ "num": 30000, "den": 1001 }`, 25 fps is `{ "num": 25, "den": 1 }`.

RelinkMedia.description:
Point a media at another file (offline media found again). Clips keep reading the same
media id; the new file is probed again.

fingerprint.description: Size + hash of the first and last megabytes of the new file (computed by the caller).

path.description: Absolute path of the new file.

RemoveKeyframe.description:
Remove the keyframe at `time`. When the last one is removed, the property becomes
constant with that keyframe's value.

RemoveMedia.description:
Remove a media from the project (the file on disk is never touched). Refused while a clip,
in any sequence, still reads it: remove those clips first.

RemoveTrack.description: Remove a track and all its clips.

RemoveTransition.description: Remove transitions (and the audio crossfades added with them, ids `<id>.a<n>`).

oneOf.description: Shows up at once (typewriter).
Rises from slightly below while fading in.

ReverseKeyframes.description:
Reverse keyframes in time: on each property, the selected keyframes are mirrored between
the first and the last of them, and their easings play backwards (ease in becomes ease out).

RippleDeleteRange.description:
Remove the time range [start, end) from the given tracks and shift everything after it
to the left by (end - start). Clips crossing the range are trimmed or split; split right
parts get ids `<id_prefix>.<n>`. Every track holding a clip linked to an affected clip
must be listed. This is the building block of silence removal.

id_prefix.description: Prefix for the ids of clips created by splits, generated by the caller.

RollEdit.description:
Roll edit: move the cut between `clip` and the clip that starts exactly where it ends, on
the same track. `clip` gets longer by `delta`, the next one shorter (or the reverse).
The sequence duration does not change.

clip.description: The clip on the left of the cut.

ScaleKeyframes.description:
Stretch or squeeze keyframes in time around `pivot`, by the factor `num / den`
(2/1 = twice as slow, 1/2 = twice as fast). `pivot` is a time in the SEQUENCE (not relative
to a clip), so keyframes of several clips scale together. They must stay within their clip.

SelectorOrder.description:
`normal`: first to last; `reverse`: last to first; `random`: shuffled with `seed`;
`from_center`: from the middle outwards (both sides together).

SetActiveSequence.description: Show another sequence (the composition tabs above the timeline).

SetClipEnabled.description: Enable or disable clips (and their linked clips). Disabled clips are neither shown nor heard.

SetClipFade.description:
Fade clips in and/or out, on top of their keyframes: video clips fade their opacity, audio
clips their volume. Only the listed clips change (list the linked audio too to fade both).
Omitted edges are left unchanged; `duration: 0` removes that fade. `fade_in + fade_out`
must fit in the clip.
Example, "fade out the music over 1 s": `{clips: ["<music clip>"],
fade_out: {duration: 705600000}}`.

SetClipProp.description:
Set a property to a constant value (removes its keyframes).
Examples: `{prop: "volume_db", value: -18}`, `{prop: "position", value: {x: 100, y: -50}}`.

SetClipSpeed.description:
Change the constant speed of media clips (and of their linked clips): 2.0 = twice as
fast, 0.5 = half speed, from 0.1 to 10; the sound keeps its pitch. The clip keeps the
same media, so its duration becomes `media / rate`. With `ripple`, what follows on every
unlocked track moves to close or open the gap; without, a longer clip stops at the next
clip (its end is cut) and a shorter one leaves a gap.
Example, slow motion at 50 %: `{clips: ["c1"], rate: 0.5, ripple: true}`.

SetCrop.description:
Crop clips: fractions of the image removed on each side (0 to 1) and rounded corners
(`radius`, 0 = square, 1 = fully round). Omitted fields are left unchanged.
Example, crop 10 % on the left and right with soft corners:
`{clips: ["c1"], crop: {left: 0.1, right: 0.1, radius: 0.2}}`.

SetKeyframe.description:
Add or replace a keyframe. The property becomes animated if it was constant.
Example, slow zoom over a 4 s clip: keyframes scale=1.0 at 0 and scale=1.1 at 2822400000.

easing.description:
Interpolation towards the next keyframe. When omitted: the easing of the keyframe
replaced at the same time, else `ease_in_out` (`linear` for `volume_db`).

time.description: Relative to the clip start, between 0 and the clip duration.

SetKeyframeEasing.description:
Set the easing of several keyframes (the curve from each one to the NEXT keyframe).
Example, "make the title come in with a bounce": the first position keyframe of the title
gets `{type: "spring", bounce: 0.5}`. "Soften every animation of the clip": every keyframe
of the clip gets `{type: "ease_in_out"}`.

SetMediaInfo.description: Store the probe result of a media (sent by the app once the background probe ends).

SetMediaRange.description:
Add or replace (same `id`) a range marked on a media: favorite, rejected, or the in/out
points (`marked`, at most one per media: a new one replaces the previous one).
Times are media times. Example, mark 12.5 s to 20 s of a rush as a favorite:
`{media: "m1", id: "<new id>", kind: "favorite", start: 8820000000, end: 14112000000,
label: "price"}`.

id.description: Range id, generated by the caller (reuse an existing id to change that range).

SetSequenceSettings.description:
Change the active sequence settings at any time, in ONE undo step. Omitted fields are left
unchanged. Setting any value turns off the automatic settings from the first clip.

Existing clips are conformed:
- new size or ratio: every video clip is rescaled and its position moved according to
  `conform` (default `fit`);
- new frame rate: every cut keeps its position in time, then snaps to the nearest frame of
  the new rate (clip starts and ends, markers). Content is kept: `source_in` follows the
  start.

Example, switch to a square 1080x1080 format keeping the picture whole:
`{width: 1080, height: 1080, conform: "fit"}`.

auto_settings.description: Re-enable (true) or disable (false) settings taken from the first clip.

conform.description:
How existing clips adapt to a new size. Default `fit`.
`#[serde(default)]` : une commande écrite avant V1 (journal, agent) reste valide.

micro_fades.description: Tiny 3 ms fades at every audio clip edge so that cuts never click (on by default).

SetTextAnimators.description:
Replace the text animators of a text clip (0.3): add, remove, reorder or change them by
sending the whole new list (`[]` removes them all). Animators by letter, word or line
select units with a range and change their offset, opacity, scale, rotation, blur, color
and tracking. Animate their numbers with `SetKeyframe`,
`prop: {text_animator: {animator: "<id>", param: "offset"}}`.
Example, words rising and fading in one after the other during the first 0.8 s:
`{clip: "c1", animators: [{id: "a1", unit: "word", shape: "ramp_down", start: {type: "static", value: 0},
  end: {type: "static", value: 40}, offset: {type: "keyframed", value: [{time: 0, value: -40, easing: {type: "linear"}},
  {time: 564480000, value: 100, easing: {type: "linear"}}]}, opacity: {type: "static", value: 0},
  position: {type: "static", value: {x: 0, y: 60}}}]}`.

SetTextContent.description: Replace the text of a text clip (style and animation are kept).

SetTextPath.description:
Lay the text of a text clip along a path (0.3), or `path: null` to put it back on straight
lines. Points are in sequence pixels from the clip center. Move the text along the path with
`SetKeyframe`, `prop: "text_path_offset"`.

SetTextStyle.description:
Change the style of text clips. Omitted fields are left unchanged.
Example, yellow text with a thick black outline:
`{clips: ["c1"], style: {fill: {type: "solid", color: "#FFE600"},
  stroke: {enabled: true, color: "#000000", width: 8}}}`.

SetTrackState.description: Change a track's state. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

ducking.description:
Audio tracks (2026-11-25): lower this track automatically while a `voice` track has
sound ("lower the music under the voice"). Live, follows every edit, no keyframe.

role.description:
Audio tracks (audit 2026-11-24): what the track carries (voice, music, ambience).
`voice` tracks drive the ducking of the other tracks.

solo.description: Audio tracks only: solo this track (others are muted while a solo exists).

volume_db.description: Audio tracks (V6, mixing desk): track volume in dB, -60 to 12.

SetTransitionParams.description:
Change a transition. Omitted fields are left unchanged. Its audio crossfades follow the
new duration.

SlideClip.description:
Slide: move a clip by `delta` while the clip ending at its start gets longer (or shorter)
and the clip starting at its end gets shorter (or longer). The content of the clip and
the sequence duration do not change.

SlipClip.description:
Slip: show another part of the media inside the same clip. Position and duration on the
timeline do not change, `source_in` moves by `delta` (keyframes stay at the same place
in the clip).

Speed.description: Playback speed of a media clip.

oneOf.description:
Constant speed: 1.0 = normal, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = slow motion (0.1 to 10).
The sound keeps its pitch.

SplitClip.description:
Cut a clip (and its linked clips) in two at timeline time `at`. The left part keeps
its id; the right part gets `new_id` (linked right parts get `<new_id>.2`, `<new_id>.3`…).

at.description: Timeline time, strictly inside the clip (snapped to the nearest frame).

new_id.description: Id of the new right part, generated by the caller.

width.description: Width of the outline outside the letters, in pixels.

TextAnimator.description:
A text animator (0.3): selects letters, words or lines with a range and changes their look
in proportion to how much each one is selected. Several animators stack, in list order.
Animate `start`, `end`, `offset`, `amount` and the properties with `SetKeyframe`,
`prop: {text_animator: {animator: "<id>", param: "offset"}}` (see `PropPath::TextAnimator`).
Example, letters rising one after the other during the first second:
`{id: "a1", unit: "letter", shape: "ramp_down", start: 0, end: 30,
  offset: <keyframes -30 at 0 s → 100 at 1 s>, opacity: 0, position: {x: 0, y: 60}}`
(selected letters are hidden and lowered; the range slides past them).

blur.description: Blur of fully selected units, in pixels (0 to 200).

easing.description: Curve applied to the selection of each unit (0 → 1).

enabled.description: A disabled animator stays in the list but does nothing.

fill.description: Fill color of fully selected units ("#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA"); none = unchanged.

id.description: Generated by the caller, unique among the animators of the clip.

offset.description: Added to start and end: animate it to sweep the range over the text.

opacity.description: Opacity of fully selected units, 0 to 1 (default 1 = unchanged).

order.description: Order in which units are taken by the range.

position.description: Offset of fully selected units, in sequence pixels (+y goes down).

range_units.description: `percent`: start, end and offset in % of the units (0 to 100); `index`: in units.

rotation.description: Rotation of fully selected units around their center, in degrees.

scale.description: Scale of fully selected units around their center (default 1 = unchanged), 0 to 20.

seed.description: Seed of the `random` order (same seed = same order, always).

shape.description: How the selection varies across the range.

tracking.description: Extra space after each selected letter, in pixels (can be negative).

unit.description: What one step of the range is: a letter, a word or a line.

TextPath.description:
Text laid along a path (0.3): the first line follows the path, the others are stacked
under it. Points are in sequence pixels from the clip center.

closed.description: The last point joins the first (circle).

offset.description:
Distance along the path where the text is placed (after alignment), in pixels.
Animate it with `SetKeyframe`, `prop: "text_path_offset"`.

points.description: At least 2 points. Handles are offsets from the point ({0, 0} = sharp corner).

TextSource.description:
Content of a text clip (title, lower third, sticker…). Rendered by the shared compositor,
identical in the viewer and in the export.

animators.description: Animators by letter, word or line (0.3), applied in order. Set with `SetTextAnimators`.

path.description: Lay the text along a path (0.3). Set with `SetTextPath`.

reveal.description:
Fraction of the words (or letters, see `style.reveal_unit`) shown, from 0 (nothing) to
1 (everything, default). Animate it with keyframes on `text_reveal` for a typewriter or
a word-by-word cascade.

text.description: The text. `\n` starts a new line.

TextStyle.description: Look of a text. Sizes are in sequence pixels.

background.description: Box or pill behind the text.

extra_shadows.description: More drop shadows under `shadow` (0.3), drawn in order. Disabled entries are skipped.

extra_strokes.description:
More outlines outside `stroke` (0.3), in order: each one wraps the previous ones
(its `width` is added outside them). Disabled entries are skipped.

font_family.description:
Font family: an embedded font ("Montserrat", "Anton", "Bebas Neue", "Archivo Black",
"Poppins", "Inter", "Bangers", "Rubik", "Nunito", "DM Serif Display"), a system font,
a font imported in the project, or "emoji" for the system emoji font (stickers).

letter_spacing.description: Extra space between letters, in pixels (can be negative).

line_height.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size (1.2 by default).

max_width.description: Wrap lines longer than this width, in pixels. 0 = no automatic wrap.

reveal_effect.description: How each word or letter appears when `reveal` passes it.

reveal_unit.description: Unit revealed by `reveal`: whole words or single letters.

stroke.description: Outline around the letters (social media style: 6 to 10 px, black).

uppercase.description: Show the text in capitals (the stored text keeps its case).

TextStylePatch.description: Change some fields of a text style; omitted fields are left unchanged.

TrackRole.description:
What an audio track carries (audit 2026-11-24). `Voice` tracks drive the ducking of the
other tracks (see `TrackDucking`); the other roles are labels for the mixing desk.

oneOf.description: No role chosen.

Transform.description:
Isolé dans sa propre struct pour pouvoir y ajouter plus tard des contraintes et des
surcharges par format (knowledge/08).

anchor.description: Pivot for scale and rotation, offset from the clip center, in source pixels.

position.description:
Offset of the clip center from the sequence center, in sequence pixels.
`{x: 0, y: 0}` = centered. +x goes right, +y goes down.

scale_xy.description:
Width and height factors (V7), multiplied with `scale`: `{x: 1, y: 1}` = unchanged.
Different values stretch the clip ("unlinked" scale in the Inspector).

TransitionDirection.description:
Direction of the motion: `left` = things move to the left (the next clip comes from the
right).

TransitionId.description: Transition id (a transition on a cut between two clips, V4).

TransitionKind.description: Kind of transition. Audio tracks only take `crossfade` (constant power).

oneOf.description: Cross dissolve (video), constant-power crossfade (audio).
Fade to black, then from black.
Fade to white, then from white.
The next clip pushes the previous one out of the frame.
The next clip slides over the previous one.
Zoom through: the previous clip grows and the next one appears.
A straight edge reveals the next clip.
The previous clip blurs out while the next one blurs in (V6, Gaussian blur).

TrimClip.description:
Move the start or end edge of a clip (and of its linked clips) by `delta`.
Positive delta moves the edge to the right: Start+ shortens the clip, End+ lengthens it.
With `ripple`, the clip start stays in place and the following clips on all unlocked
tracks shift to close or open the gap. A delta that would go past the start or end of the
media stops at that edge (to the frame).

UnlinkClips.description: Unlink clips so they can be edited separately.

UpdateMarker.description: Change a marker. Omitted fields are left unchanged.
